description: A contemporary open-plan office lounge area photographed at standing eye-level from a three-quarter corner angle, capturing both the casual seating zone in the foreground and the open workstation area receding behind. The space features floor-to-ceiling glass curtain walls along the left and rear elevations, flooding the interior with cool, even daylight from what appears to be an overcast urban exterior. A dropped white ceiling with a slatted wood accent panel runs diagonally through the upper right quadrant, adding warmth and texture against the predominantly white ceiling plane. In the foreground, a tufted light-grey modular sofa anchors the lounge zone, dressed with a woven geometric cushion and a mustard-yellow pillow. Two cognac-leather low armchairs with slender matte-black metal legs flank a pair of small round light-oak side tables. A flat-woven geometric rug in grey and ivory grounds the seating cluster. Large mature potted plants — a Ficus benjamina and a tropical-leafed specimen — punctuate the boundary between lounge and workspace, adding biophilic softness. The workstation zone behind features rows of light-oak bench desks with task chairs in matte black mesh. A cylindrical concrete column marks the transition between zones. The palette is dominated by cool greys, warm cognac, and natural oak, with mustard as a singular warm accent. Warm downward washes illuminate the work surfaces while the lounge zone sits under diffused overhead light.
